description: Designed by scripts/director.py design (seed 1): the roles, ages, styles and colours were dealt by code, the rooms written from the picture of the wallpaper by a model; each slot carries its own kit. Re-shoot under a NEW set name.

kit.name: Flower table and ochre poufs
kit.subject: a bright Playful Curves bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table and a stack of round bouclé poufs
kit.room: A calm airy room with a pale ash floor and cream walls.
kit.floor: A scalloped felt rug in deep eucalyptus green holds wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book, with one small wooden arch block beside them.
kit.side_wall: a flower-shaped craft table 45 cm high in pale lacquered birch, with a stack of two round bouclé poufs in warm ochre and barberry red beside it, and a small arch-shaped framed picture above
kit.light: Crisp morning daylight from a window on the {side} lies in clear patches on the floor.
kit.palette: eucalyptus green, pale birch, warm ochre, barberry red, cream and white
kit.items: flower-shaped craft table, bouclé poufs, scalloped rug, crayon cup, drawing book, arch block, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug

kit.name: Birch desk and striped bed
kit.subject: a warm Fun Haus bedroom for a child aged 6 to 10, with a curved birch study desk and a low striped single bed
kit.room: A sunny tidy room with a dark walnut herringbone floor.
kit.floor: A flat-weave rug in sand and brick red lies on the floor, with a classic globe on a turned solid wood stand beside the bed.
kit.side_wall: a curved birch study desk 75 cm high with an open book ledge, illustrated books, wooden pencil cups and an ergonomic wooden chair, beside a single bed 90 by 200 cm in a low frame with caramel-and-cream striped bedding and one blue cushion, and a small framed vintage circus picture above the desk
kit.light: Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the {side} lie in soft patches on the floor.
kit.palette: soft sand, caramel, brick red, cream, saturated blue and walnut brown and
kit.items: study desk, book ledge, wooden chair, striped bed, globe, rug, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
